full_page.content:
1934, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 172 Cont.
Jan. 30 Mrs. A. LeClair - 23 - Husband out of work would like to get back to her own old position or something to help.
James K. Casey Jr. - 20 - Seattle - ostamalitis - enrolled.
30 Al Goretski - 47 - from Pt. Austin - operation on Friday - tumor on bladder.
Therese Mc Cabe - 50 - in accident Jan. 27th- very little hope To- day - enrolled at 2:40
31 Mrs. D. Lutcliffe-27- has Bulchavik husband & 3 .. now in hospital after serious operation,has not been to duty for two yrs. Her father asks prayers Enrolled her To-day ... Father Convert Dr. - for- mer lutheran minister.
Genevieve Coyle - 5 - whooping .... asks prayers her-self. Mrs. A. Demier - 40 - rather hopeless internal cancer. A. Callewaert - 74 - asthma .. pneum. feared.
Page 173 Feb. 1 Donald Rushven - 19 - presbiterian - Epileptic.
1934, February
1-2 Martin W. Ewald - 52 - convert-five yrs. cancer of spine, sarcoma feared, pains terrible; promises daily communion for year if father gets well. Starts today to receive daily. Feb. 7th Reports - very much improved - able to take bath yesterday. Hopes reviving that Dr's dic'tum "death in 90" days will be frustra- ted- poo pooed. Son, Martin J. - 27 - wife & 2 depending on him - threatened with mastoid - asks prayers for himself as well as father.
3rd. Vincent - 32 - Zagar - trouble with police - wrong identification. Mrs. Gorman's - 80 - Rec. Hosp. - Rose Markley
P. Hulston - 45 - Sponger, Aunt and relatives ask prayer that he wake up and have principles & character.
Gustav. Vandesteene - 64 - had erysipelas & abcesses in head very slow improving.
Rev. R. Thomas - Pontiac - T.B.
